description: listInvoices: List invoices for the authenticated user with optional status filtering and pagination. Requires authentication.

page.description: Zero-based page number for pagination, default 0.

sessionKey.description: Session key (osk_...) returned by checkDeviceLoginStatus. Pass it on every call when logged in via the in-chat device flow; omit when connected via OAuth.

size.description: Number of invoices per page, default 20.

status.description: Filter by invoice status: DRAFT, PENDING, PAID, CANCELLED, or OVERDUE.

name: listInvoices
